hook.title: I'm building a talking Destiny *Ghost*. Part 1: the design.

scenes.title: Designed to *open* like the in-game scan

end.title: Part 2: the *first print*
end.sub: follow to see if it works

caption:
Part 1 of building a talking Ghost from Destiny: the design.

No CAD. A Python script generates all 12 parts, matched view by view to the Bungie reference sheet. Estimated 32 hours of printing and about 500 g of filament. The shell is designed to spread open like the in-game scan, with one servo pulling all 8 pieces shut.

Going inside: a Raspberry Pi 4, a round 1.28" screen for the eye, a mic, a speaker, and Claude for the personality.

Next up is the first print. Follow to see whether it works.

Fan project. Destiny and the Ghost belong to Bungie.
